## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

Before handing over to buck2, tk probes the server with a sub-second timeout. If the server is unreachable and can't be started, the run goes ahead uncached (runner mode `off`) with a one-line warning. buck2's ~45s-then-fail behaviour never happens (spec §6).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With the port held by something else, or the server unable to start, `tk test` runs uncached, prints one warning line, and doesn't slow down noticeably
- [ ] No test is reported failed because of the cache
- [ ] The probe adds well under a second to `tk test` when the server is up

## Blocked by

- turnkey-vnm.7
title: tk test falls back to uncached when the cache is unreachable
